checks.title: Possible duplicate patient charts
checks.hint: Same name and date of birth under different Denticon ids. Lender rows for these people come back as 'ambiguous' until the charts are merged in Denticon.

checks.title: Possible duplicate applications
checks.hint: Same patient, lender and submitted date under different reference ids. Usually the same application exported twice.

checks.title: Cases funded through more than one lender
checks.hint: A patient's round of applications has fundings at two lenders. Either two treatments were grouped into one case (widen/narrow FINANCING_CASE_WINDOW_DAYS or add a request-id column), or it's a genuine split — worth a look.

checks.title: Applications not grouped into a case
checks.hint: Not counted in the funnel's financing stages. Run POST /api/finance/cases/rebuild.

checks.title: Applications with unknown prime/subprime tier
checks.hint: The lender runs both programs and the export didn't say which. Excluded from the Prime vs SubPrime filter. Re-import with a Program/Tier column, or if the lender really runs one program, fix it under lenders and run retier.

checks.title: Locations with the same name
checks.hint: Two location rows share a name — the Practice filter will show it twice. Usually a seeded location next to a Denticon-synced one; reset with `npm run seed -- --reset-only`.

checks.title: Applications not linked to a patient
checks.hint: Counted in the funnel but can't be filtered by provider or new-patient status. Retried after every Denticon sync.

checks.title: Applications with no submitted date
checks.hint: Invisible in every date-filtered report and funnel. Fix the export or add the date column.

checks.title: Approved with no approved amount
checks.hint: Approval rate is fine; utilisation % can't be computed for these.

checks.title: Funded more than approved
checks.hint: Utilisation over 100% — usually a limit increase the export didn't carry, or swapped columns.

checks.title: Decided before submitted
checks.hint: Decision date earlier than submitted date — likely swapped date columns in the export.

checks.title: Patients missing location, provider or first visit
checks.hint: Drop out of the corresponding filters. Location/provider gaps usually mean an office or provider outside the key's scope; missing first visit = never seen yet.

checks.title: Treatment plans missing fee or presented date
checks.hint: Fee-less plans contribute $0 to case value; date-less plans never show in the 'treatment presented' stage.

checks.title: Denticon staging rows waiting to be processed
checks.hint: Treatment plans whose patient hasn't synced yet, or a sync that stopped before processing. Clears on the next run.

checks.title: Denticon data download (BCP) feed is stale
checks.hint: No successful BCP load in the last 2 day(s). Check the inbox folder, the zip password, and the last load's error via GET /api/bcp/loads. Silent when the feed has never been loaded.

checks.title: BCP loads that failed
checks.hint: The most recent loads that ended in an error (wrong password, unreadable zip, database error). Fix and re-run `npm run bcp:load`; nothing partial is promoted from a failed load.

checks.title: BCP tables landed but not promoted
checks.hint: Files in the latest download we have no adapter or column names for. They're kept raw in staging_bcp_rows; add columns/map entries to bcp-feed.json (see docs/denticon-bcp.md) to bring them into the dashboard.
